coordinate_system.orientation_notes: Use the section-view frame: X follows the tube axis, Y is radial in the section plane, and Z is the section-cut normal. The left view looks along X. The detail-view axial notation is treated as local rather than as the world-axis definition.

features.name: Internal corner chamfer
features.description: 45-degree chamfer located at the internal corner/shoulder of the tube wall, specified at both ends.

geometry.position_description: At internal bore/shoulder corner at both ends of the inner tube

features.name: Outer cylindrical surface
features.description: Main outer cylindrical body of the inner tube with outer diameter 154.75/154.50 mm and variable length 'A'.

features.name: Central through bore
features.description: Through bore extending along the X axis with inner diameter 142.13/142.00 mm and chamfered entry edges at both ends.

relationships.detail: The central bore and outer cylindrical surface share the tube axis, corroborated by the concentric end-view silhouettes.
The detail identifies internal corner chamfers at both ends, corresponding to the chamfered bore entry edges described in the section.

assumptions.text: The outer cylinder, central bore, and end-chamfer pair remain separate singleton observations. The X detail marker locates a corner treatment on the tube; it does not make the chamfer and the complete outer cylindrical surface the same physical feature.

The explicit internal-corner identification in VIEW X, corroborated by the section bore's chamfered-entry description and the end-view inner-edge context, governs chamfer placement. The parent view's outer-corner wording is treated as an approximate description of the detail-marker location.

The section-view coordinate frame governs global orientation because it explicitly defines the tube axis and is consistent with the left-view viewing direction. The detail's differing axial notation is interpreted as local; no source geometry fields are rewritten.
The required tube length “A” is assumed to be 65 mm, derived from the drawing scale relative to the specified outer diameter of 154.75 mm.
